notablePrerequisites: Marwyn does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Marwyn by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} equal to its power.
Cast Wurmcalling with buyback by paying a total of at least {5}{G}{G}.
Raggadragga's third ability triggers, giving Marwyn +7/+7 until end of turn and untapping Marwyn.
Resolve Wurmcalling, creating a Wurm creature token and returning Wurmcalling to your hand.
Repeat.
